02

Synthesis protocolOrdered operations, material dependencies and stage-specific conditions

01
fractionation

Charge and evacuate the short-path apparatus

Charge10mL neat TOPSe to one-neck flask with short-path distillation head and receiving flask. Evacuate50mTorr; heat slowly.

initial topse volume
10 mLreported · Source status: reported. Source unit: evans2010-topse-distillation. Source scope: TOPSe fractions A and C plus two unlabelled cuts.
pressure
50 mTorrreported · Source status: reported. Source unit: evans2010-topse-distillation. Source scope: TOPSe fractions A and C plus two unlabelled cuts.
Environment: One-neck flask; short-path head; receiving flaskEndpoint: Not reported

evans2010 · SI PDF p. 6 (printed S6), Fractional distillation of neat TOPSe
02
fractionation

Collect A and two unlabelled distillation cuts

Collect A starting185°C for2mL. Collect two further2mL cuts at190°C and195°C; these cuts are not labelled B. The output state denotes three physically separate collected fractions, not a pooled solution. The separate residual-pot output remains in the original flask and supplies residue C; it is not pooled with the distillate cuts.
